note: Curated, not measured. Baseline models from vendor or faithful-quant publishers only; no fine-tunes. Entries come from the Ollama library and Hugging Face as of the update date and have not been benchmarked by probe. Speed and quality claims are the publishers' own; task tags follow the publishers' stated capabilities (tools, thinking, vision). Run with --online to fit each entry from its registry header.
